Attached at one end is a simple church gable with narrow Gothic pointed-arch windows, plain slate roof and a modest small roof bellcote, no grand baroque dome or enormous tower. A glimpse through the gateway suggests a quiet enclosed convent courtyard. Small modest old-town houses beyond.

Plain brown woolen habits, hoods hanging behind or covering the backs of their heads, coarse pale rope belts with simple visible knots and dangling rope ends. All rear-facing: no profiles, facial features, eyes or mouths. No real-person likeness and no other people.
Composition and camera: broad real-camera architectural view from slightly raised street level, perhaps a low stoop, normal 40mm lens perspective with straight natural masonry lines. Cobblestone street spans the foreground; entire long monastery façade and church gable dominate the middle distance, the three small rear-facing friars near the gateway provide scale. Do not substitute the current city square: buildings still occupy it. Full 3:2 frame without border.
Light and textures: convincingly real-camera PHOTOREALISTIC historical reconstruction, calm soft afternoon daylight under thin cloud, muted limestone-grey, sandstone, worn slate, natural brown cloth and pale rope. Believable rough masonry joints, uneven cobbles, weathered wood and matte wool, normal exposure and natural depth. No drawing, engraving, historical print, painting, illustration, stylized render, CGI gloss, HDR, cinematic grading or oversaturation.
